column1: # Where to watch: the apps Lumen Home offers for a showcase title (Смотреть в ...) and in search (Искать в).
# Read by org.lumen.home.watch.WatchApps. One row per app, tab separated:
#   packages   every package name of the app (TV and phone builds, forks), comma separated
#   name       the name shown on the button and the tile
#   in_ru      the Russian phrase after "Смотреть" (в Кинопоиске)
#   kind       provider = official service, the title must be in its TMDB watch providers for the region
#              catalog  = universal catalogue app that plays almost any title (offered for every released title)
#              platform = video platform (search only, never on the hero button)
#   tmdb       TMDB watch provider ids of the service (- = none known), see /watch/providers/movie
#   open       tmdb   = VIEW https://www.themoviedb.org/<movie|tv>/<id> in the app (Lampa: MainActivity.parseUriData)
#              search = ACTION_SEARCH with SearchManager.QUERY (used only when the app really declares it)
#              url:T  = VIEW of the url T in the app, {q} = the query
#              launch = no reliable intent: the app opens, the query stays in Lumen search
# Order matters: inside a kind the first installed app wins. Priority on the hero: a provider that has the title,
# then catalog apps (Lampa first), then Lumen search.
